title: Both Bodies of a Vowel
label: ch:bn-both-bodies-of-a-vowel
canDo: I can read six more Bengali words I already say — চা, পরিবার, জল, নীল, ভাই and এক — and say which of a vowel's two forms to write, and why, from whether there is a consonant in front of it.

payoff.summary: One is read as a vowel that opens a word with no consonant to carry it, which finally makes visible the claim the numbers chapter could only assert; then all six of the chapter's words are read back with nothing new introduced.
